Title: Started a Protein Shake, Iron Pill, or Antacid? Here's Why You're Constipated

Description:
Started taking a protein shake, an iron pill, or a daily antacid recently — and now you're straining on the toilet for the first time in years? It's probably not your diet. It's one of these three.

Fiber pulls water into your stool and keeps it moving. Whey protein has almost no fiber, and digesting that much protein makes your kidneys use extra water to flush out the waste. Iron pills only get partially absorbed, and the rest can irritate your gut. Calcium-based antacids like Tums neutralize stomach acid to calm heartburn — but the calcium itself also tightens smooth muscle, slowing your gut down too.

Watch for a simple swap for each one.
